verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated privacy help page saying users can opt out of model training in Settings, which delivers the core of the story. Community worries about data being sold are general skepticism, not concrete contradiction, so they don't create a dispute. Missing for 10: details on scope and defaults (it implies training is on by default), any statement covering third-party AI providers or workspace/admin-level controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works.
